note: Built at the University of St Andrews School of Medicine, per the homepage ('Backed by University of St Andrews'). Research cited on the homepage is the company's own; papers are linked but not saved.

product_category.value: AI-simulated patient platform for communication and history-taking training in medical education, with scenario authoring and rubric-based grading.

evidence.quote: Author realistic scenarios. GP consultations, interviews, difficult conversations. Grade every interaction against your own rubric.

platforms.note: The pages describe text, voice and live video avatar modes ('The learner consults the patient by text, voice, or live video avatar') and 'PRACTICE ANYWHERE, ANY TIME', but do not say whether learners use a browser, an app or a headset. No headset term appears on the 3 pages read.

evidence.quote: The learner consults the patient by text, voice, or live video avatar, and every moment is recorded.

target_customer.value: Universities, medical schools, postgraduate training programmes, clinical-skills departments and training bodies; students practise history-taking and consultations.

evidence.quote: For Universities, Medical Schools & Training Bodies
Tailored pricing for medical schools, postgraduate training programmes and clinical-skills departments.

value_proposition.value: Gives every learner unlimited, structured, rubric-graded consultation practice between simulated-patient sessions, which the company says are expensive, hard to scale, time-consuming and not standardised.

evidence.quote: giving every learner an unlimited supply of structured, rubric-graded practice
Simulated patients carry a real per-session cost that scales with every cohort.

value_proposition.note: The company says it does not replace simulated patients for high-stakes assessment.

tagline.note: No official tagline found: no slogan is marked ™, ® or ℠, and no slogan repeats across the pages read. Homepage headline: 'AI-simulated communication training, at scale.'; also 'Built by educators, for educators.'

pricing.value: Not published; tailored proposal on request. Priced per institution with unlimited learners; the same page also describes session-based charging, with yearly or multi-year subscriptions and onboarding included.

evidence.quote: SimPatient is priced per institution, not per seat.
Users are charged based on the sessions they take, not seats.
All pricing is per-organisation and includes unlimited learners. Get tailored pricing on the call.

pricing.note: The pricing page mentions both a per-institution price and session-based charging; both are recorded as written.
